scope: Bounded original registration and damage-write audit, not every external caller
findings: MainRegistry.aMatEuph uses durability factor 15000000; ArmorEuphemium.setDamage(ItemStack,int) is explicitly no-op.

Audited MainRegistry tool materials maximum durability 10000. Direct setMaxDamage item registrations and constructors used by repair kits/stamps/blades/inserts/revive/canteen/degradation are below 65536.
FluidIDMulti writes fluid1 integer to metadata; actual fluid registration range and arbitrary external control data are separate from this root.
Large batteries/armor power and fuel values are NBT energy/yield values, not raw itemDamage. No ordinary >65535 damage producer established by this bounded audit.
